title: Signal: Server trust accepted from the challenge without evaluation in swift — review required
scope: Single-line match on trust-based credentials in swift.
limitations: Lexical: matches the credential construction; a prior explicit evaluation in the same method is not linked.

examples.line: # audit: let credential = URLCredential(trust: challenge.serverTrust!) present
# verified: guard SecTrustEvaluateWithError(challenge.serverTrust!, nil) else { completionHandler(.cancelAuthenticationChallenge, nil); return }

fpNotes: A delegate that evaluates the trust immediately before this line is the accepted, reviewed exception.
